subject: AvaCare Health — commercial handoff + kickoff request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@avacarehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@avacarehealth.com>, Anne Park <anne.park@avacarehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AvaCare Health — commercial handoff + kickoff request

Team — thanks again to everyone for getting AvaCare to signature. Quick context and an ask to stand up the CS/implementation team so we can hit their tight go-live window. High-level deal facts (commercial):
- Term: 3 years, committed reserved capacity: 4x v100-equivalent GPUs (dedicated) with 1.5M tokens/day baseline.
- SLA target: 99.9% uptime; target p50 latency for chat flows ~120ms (customer wants latency-focused routing).
- Data residency: EU (primary), customer has EU-only requirement.
- Primary use case: real-time clinician assistance + batch nightly embedding refresh for search.
- Billing: committed monthly + overage; signed MSA attached (signed_MSA.pdf).

Immediate asks:
1) CS owner: please nominate primary and backup and confirm capacity to run weekly 1-hour kickoff next Wed (2026-07-14) at 14:00 CEST.
2) Implementation: list technical leads and SE for model/throughput runbook. Customer will require a pre-production staging window next week to validate perf.
3) Security & compliance: they attached a completed security questionnaire (AvaCare_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — need SRE/infosec review for EU KMS integration and audit log retention (90 days).
4) Operational handovers: provide the mutual action plan link + any onboarding checklist items you want on the kickoff agenda.

Jordan — looping you into our internal thread so CS/implementation owners can coordinate access and timelines. If any of the deal facts above are off, flag back and I will correct.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0193
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@avacarehealth.com>, Procurement <procure@avacarehealth.com>, Anne Park <anne.park@avacarehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AvaCare Health — commercial handoff + kickoff request

Thanks Jonas — congrats team. I can take primary CS ownership for post-sign onboarding; backup will be Tessa if my week gets blocked. A few clarifying asks before we lock the kickoff: 
- Can you confirm the committed QPS and SLO target broken out by the two product flows (real-time chat vs nightly embedding job)? I want to ensure we size staging and the pre-prod load test appropriately.
- Is the EU residency requirement a hard stop (no US backups) or do they permit a geo-failover with data encryption keys held in EU KMS?
- Please share the installation SOW (if separate from MSA) or point me to the Confluence runbook for deployment specifics.

I'll propose a kickoff agenda: 1) Introductions + owners; 2) Success criteria and preflight checklist; 3) Staging window & perf test plan; 4) Security & KMS / audit-log integration; 5) Rollout timeline & rollback plan.

CC'ing Tessa for implementation details and Rafael for SE deep-dive.

— Grace
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@avacarehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@avacarehealth.com>, Anne Park <anne.park@avacarehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T12:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AvaCare Health — commercial handoff + kickoff request

Jonas / Grace — thanks and excited to get started. Quick answers from our side: 
- The EU residency is strict for production PHI-related traffic; we can accept a cross-region read-replica for non-PHI telemetry but keys and primary data must remain in EU KMS.
- Target load: real-time flow average 120 qps with spikes to 350 qps during shift changes; nightly embedding job processes ~2M documents (we'll provide S3 manifest).
- Procurement contact is cc'd (procure@avacarehealth.com) and will confirm the final payment schedule; signed MSA already uploaded to DocuSign (link below).
- Attaching our security questionnaire answers (AvaCare_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). We need to review any additional SOC2 evidence and pen-test dates.

Kickoff window next Wed works for us — prefer 14:00 CEST. Please share dial-in and a short agenda.

Jordan Liu
Director of Engineering, AvaCare Health
jordan.liu@avacarehealth.com

Subject: Re: AvaCare Health — commercial handoff + kickoff request

Putting down the kickoff checklist and immediate owners/tasks so the team has a single view. I'll maintain this as the running preflight.

Triage checklist (owners + due dates):
- SOW / deployment runbook (Tessa) — draft 2026-07-11 COB; include staging/perf test steps, rollback conditions, and cutover checklist.
- Staging data manifest + S3 access (Jordan) — by 2026-07-12 EOD. Provide example presigned URLs and expected doc counts.
- Perf test harness + k6 script (Rafael) — draft 2026-07-12; target: simulate 350 qps spikes and sustained 120 qps for 30 mins.
- EU KMS integration plan (Grace + Security) — identify required key rollover windows; initial review 2026-07-13 AM.
- Audit/log retention confirmation & SOC2 evidence request (Grace) — list delivered to Jordan 2026-07-12.
- Access: create staging tenant and invite tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com (Jordan).

Acceptance criteria (short):
1) Staging perf: 99% of requests under 250ms for p95 during 120 qps sustained; tolerable p95 up to 450ms during the 350 qps spike test.
2) Data residency: all PHI-tagged data remains in EU KMS and audit logs show no egress outside EU region.
3) Nightly job: embeddings pipeline completes under 3 hours for 2M docs in staging.

I'll send a calendar invite for the 7/14 kickoff (45 minutes) and include the agenda. Rafael — please attach the perf-harness and a quick runbook excerpt to the calendar invite. Jordan — once I have the S3 manifest we will provision the staging tenant and kick off the perf test schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
